subject: Operations

findings.subject: Operations
findings.title: No retry with backoff for transient database failures
findings.recommendation: Add a bounded exponential-backoff retry for transient connection errors (e.g. a Polly resilience pipeline, SqlRetryLogicProvider, or Npgsql retry), applied to the connect step and the idempotent reset.

findings.subject: Operations
findings.title: No circuit breaker protecting calls to the database dependency
findings.recommendation: Add a circuit breaker (e.g. Polly CircuitBreaker strategy in a shared resilience pipeline) around database access so a degraded DB fails fast instead of tying up requests for the full connect timeout.

strengths.subject: Operations
strengths.title: Database connect timeout is explicitly configured and applied to connection strings

notes: REL-01 passes on explicit DB connect timeout; command timeout relies on the finite provider default (30s) and OTLP exporters use SDK default timeouts.
